name: Adreanna Limbach
reason: Too thin: her own site (adreannalimbach.com) offers one book (Tea and Cake With Demons) and 1-on-1 meditation mentorship with no price; her free 'DAILY Meditation' library pages (2020) no longer carry any videos, her 1-on-1 Meditation Instructor Training runs 7 Oct to 10 Nov (already started), and no YouTube channel of her own was found, so fewer than three usable items. Her site does name Omega (retreats) and publishes hello@adreannalimbach.com, so she could be revisited if she adds courses.
